messages:
Maya (Growth): Quick heads-up — CloudSynergy marketplace listing goes live next Tue. We need coordinated assets: launch post, 1-page benchmark narrative, joint webinar landing + signup flow, and inbound lead routing. Can we confirm owners and cutoffs?
Sanjay (PM): I can own the webinar logistics + signup flow. Timeline looks tight though — when do you need the webinar deck?
Maya (Growth): Thanks Sanjay. Deck draft by EOD Thu would be ideal so Ellie can craft messaging. Also need a short technical benchmark summary (200–300 words) and 3 pull quotes we can use for social.
Ellie (Content): Got it. I’ll draft the benchmark narrative from the eng summary. Can someone drop the perf numbers and test conditions here?
Ryan (Field): Sharing quick snapshot — internal perf against open-llama-large: 99% parity on intent prompts, avg latency 120ms p50 on our Dedicated profile (batch=1, seq=512). Will paste more details.
Ryan (Field): 
```
Benchmark: 5000 prompts (mix: 60% instruction, 40% chat), seq=512
Model: open-llama-large (baseline)
Redwood variant: rwd-whisper-quant (INT8)
Throughput: 300 reqs/s sustained
Latency: p50 120ms, p95 420ms
Notes: KV cache warm, cache-hit rate ~18% for corpus
```
Ellie (Content): Perfect — that gives me what I need. I’ll turn this into a 250-word narrative + three pull quotes by tomorrow morning.
Jordan (Sales): For inbound leads: partner marketplace sends interest webhook to us, then we want to route to SDR queue A for enterprise leads and to self-serve nurture for SMB. Can we confirm lead fields?
PartnerBot: Incoming webhook schema: {customer_size, cloud_region, interest_tier, email, company, note}. See https://partners.cloudsynergy.com/webhooks for details.
Sanjay (PM): Proposed routing rules (quick):
```
if interest_tier == "enterprise" or company_revenue > 50M -> SDR_A
elif interest_tier == "platform" and cloud_region == "US" -> Field_Oncall
else -> self_serve_nurture
```
Maya (Growth): That routing looks good. @Jordan please confirm SDR contact list and SLA for initial touch.
Jordan (Sales): Confirmed — SDR_A roster and 24h SLA. I’ll add to the routing doc and share a CSV.
Ellie (Content): Messaging iteration plan: I’ll prepare 3 headline variations for the launch post and 2 narrative angles for the benchmark (performance-first vs. cost-efficiency). We can A/B in the newsletter and on the marketplace.
Maya (Growth): Love it. Quick checklist: 1) Benchmark narrative + pull quotes (Ellie) — due tomorrow AM; 2) Webinar deck draft (Sanjay) — due Thu EOD; 3) Landing page + CTA copy (Ellie+Sanjay) — Fri noon; 4) Inbound routing YAML & webhook test (Sanjay+Jordan) — Fri EOD; 5) Launch post + social assets (Maya+Ellie) — Mon morning.
Sanjay (PM): I’ll spin up a staging webhook endpoint and share curl test commands in this thread by tomorrow.
Maya (Growth): One risk: marketplace editorial may edit headline. Please keep social-first and marketplace-first copy separate.
Ellie (Content): Noted — I’ll create 2 copy files: marketplace-ready + social-ready.
Ryan (Field): If possible, include a short engineering appendix for the benchmark in the assets zip (1-page with testbed + config). I can draft that.
Maya (Growth): Great — Ryan please attach appendix to the draft assets folder.
Jordan (Sales): Also, can we add a quick chat flow for leads coming from the webinar signup? Need to route hot leads directly to SDR.
Sanjay (PM): Adding a webhook call on form-submit for "hot_lead": true. Example: `POST /webhook {"email":"...","hot_lead":true}`. Will include in routing doc.
Maya (Growth): Final ask — can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you’ve uploaded your deliverable? I’ll collate and send the partner handoff pack to CloudSynergy on Mon morning.
PartnerBot: Reminder scheduled: "Send partner handoff pack" on Mon 09:00 UTC (created by Maya).
Ellie (Content): :thumbsup: I’ll upload benchmark + copy by 09:00 tomorrow.
Sanjay (PM): :thumbsup: webinar deck draft in progress.
Ryan (Field): :thumbsup: appendix coming tonight.
Jordan (Sales): :thumbsup: routing CSV ready to upload by Fri.
Maya (Growth): Thanks team — feeling good about this. I’ll post final timeline and the handoff checklist in a follow-up thread with attachments.
